subtitle: Your working day on one screen.

agent.title: Radal agent
agent.subtitle: Ask about your policies, collections and placements. The agent reads your data and proposes actions you confirm.
agent.emptyHint: Mention an insured or a placement with @, use / for commands or turn on a skill below the message box.
agent.placeholder: Type your question… (@ to mention, / for commands)
agent.fallback: Answer delivered without streaming (CloudFront buffers the body into one chunk).
agent.composerHint: Enter sends · Shift+Enter new line · writes always ask for your confirmation

skills.hint: A skill gives the agent the full method for a task. Turn it on here or let the agent load it.

home.intro: I'm your copilot. I look up your policies, collections and accounts, answer with your data and prepare actions for you to confirm.
home.scopeMineHint: Figures for the accounts and policies you own.
home.indicatorsError: We couldn't load your numbers. You can still chat.
home.queriesHint: Pick one and the copilot starts the conversation for you.
home.placeholder: Ask your copilot… (@ to mention, / for commands)
home.startError: We couldn't open the conversation. Please try again.
home.skillWarning: The conversation started without the suggested skill.

overdue_review.label: Review overdue installments
overdue_review.prompt: Review my collections: which installments are overdue, which put the policy at risk of termination and what I should ask each insurer.

pending_evidence_review.label: Confirm reported payments
pending_evidence_review.prompt: Show me the payments the insureds reported that are still unconfirmed, and tell me which ones I can mark as paid.

ask_insurer_status.label: Ask insurers for payment status
ask_insurer_status.prompt: Which insurers should I ask about the payment status of overdue installments? Draft the inquiries for me.

register_policy.label: Register a policy
register_policy.prompt: I want to register a new policy. Walk me through the data you need.

renewals_upcoming.label: Upcoming renewals
renewals_upcoming.prompt: Which policies expire in the next 60 days and what is the status of each renewal?

portfolio_summary.label: Portfolio summary
portfolio_summary.prompt: Give me a summary of my portfolio: active policies, total premium in UF and how it splits by line and by insurer.

missing_files.label: Missing files
missing_files.prompt: Which accounts and policies have missing files or data? Sort them by urgency.

due_this_week.label: Installments due this week
due_this_week.prompt: Which installments are due this week and whom should I remind to pay?

policies_incomplete.label: Policies with incomplete data
policies_incomplete.prompt: Which policies have incomplete or provisional data I should fill in?

top_insured.label: My top insureds
top_insured.prompt: Who are my 5 insureds with the most active premium, in UF?

insurer_mix.label: Premium by insurer
insurer_mix.prompt: How does my active premium split by insurer? Show it in UF and as a percentage.

stalled_accounts.label: Stalled accounts
stalled_accounts.prompt: Which accounts have been stuck in the same stage the longest and what do they need to move forward?

policy_documents.label: Policies without a document
policy_documents.prompt: Which policies do not have their policy PDF uploaded?
